Mulund East railway station is reachable within a 15-minute walk, providing efficient access to the city's suburban rail network. The neighbourhood is well-served by a variety of retail stores, banks, and essential services. Its proximity to major landmarks and transit routes makes it a highly practical choice for professionals and families seeking a central and well-established address.

Recreational amenities such as a childrens play area and kids club make it particularly appealing for families. Additionally, rooftop amenities add to the lifestyle quotient, offering spaces for relaxation and social interaction within the complex.LocalityStrategically located near the Times of India office in Malad East, the property enjoys excellent connectivity to major highways, metro lines, and railway stations, making daily commuting convenient. Malad East is a well-developed suburb known for its mix of residential and commercial infrastructure, providing easy access to schools, healthcare centres, shopping malls, and entertainment hubs. The neighbourhood continues to grow as a preferred residential destination due to its accessibility and urban conveniences, while still offering pockets of residential calm.This apartment stands out as a practical and future-ready home, combining location advantages, modern amenities, and the flexibility of a newly constructed space in one of Mumbais dynamic localities.

With its strategic location, modern construction and practical living spaces, this apartment presents an excellent opportunity for homebuyers looking to establish themselves in a dynamic and well-connected neighbourhood.

plgdtldesc: Experience elevated urban living with this well-positioned 2 BHK apartment in Runwal Bliss, located in CGS Colony, Kanjurmarg East, Mumbai. Offering a carpet area of 670 sq. ft, this ready-to-move-in residence is situated on the 20th floor of a modern 50-storey tower, providing impressive views of Airoli Creek and the surrounding skyline. Developed by Runwal Enterprises, the project is relatively new with an age of less than 5 years, ensuring contemporary construction quality and design. This semi-furnished resale property is ideal for homebuyers seeking a premium lifestyle in a well-connected and rapidly developing locality.Property SpecificationsThe apartment features two bedrooms, both currently unfurnished, allowing buyers the flexibility to design interiors as per their preferences. The flooring is finished with elegant wooden textures, with variation in the master bedroom adding a distinct touch. The flat includes two bathrooms, one attached to the master bedroom and one common, both equipped with western-style fittings, geysers, and necessary fixtures. The living space is well-planned with access to a balcony that overlooks the scenic Airoli Creek, ensuring ample natural light and ventilation. The kitchen is functional and supported by a piped gas connection, though it does not include a modular setup or chimney. Electrical fittings such as lights and fans are already installed.FacilitiesRunwal Bliss offers a host of modern amenities and essential facilities to enhance everyday living. Residents benefit from 100 percent power backup, round-the-clock water supply, and robust security with CCTV surveillance and guards. The apartment comes with a covered parking space for added convenience. The society includes lifestyle features such as a clubhouse, swimming pool, kids play area, and dedicated childrens water play zones, creating a family-friendly environment. High-speed lifts and well-maintained common areas further contribute to a comfortable residential experience.LocalityKanjurmarg East is a well-connected suburb in Mumbai known for its growing infrastructure and accessibility. The property enjoys proximity to reputed educational institutions such as St. Xavier High School and Junior College, IES Bhandup Primary English School, and Kendriya Vidyalaya IIT Powai. Kanjurmarg Railway Station is nearby, ensuring seamless connectivity across Mumbai, along with access to metro and bus services. The locality also offers easy reach to daily conveniences including markets, healthcare facilities, and shopping destinations, making it an ideal choice for modern urban living.

plgdtldesc: 2 BHK Furnished Apartment for Sale on Altamount Road, MumbaiSet on one of South Mumbai’s most prestigious residential stretches, this refined 2 BHK apartment on Altamount Road offers an elevated living experience defined by space, views and prime connectivity. Positioned on a higher floor within a well-established residential tower, the apartment enjoys panoramic sea-facing aspects from multiple sides along with the convenience of a fully furnished, ready-to-move-in home suited to discerning end users.Property SpecificationsThe apartment has a carpet area of approximately 1200 sq. ft and is situated on the 24th floor of a 31-storey building. It is a freehold property available on a resale basis and is ready for immediate possession. The layout comprises two well-proportioned bedrooms, three bathrooms and two balconies connected to the living area, both offering sea views. An additional store room is provided, along with a separate staff bathroom connected to the utility and washing machine area. The main entrance faces east, while the apartment as a whole enjoys a west-facing orientation. Flooring throughout the residence is uniform and finished in premium Italian marble, vitrified tiles and granite. The property is over 20 years old and has been well maintained.FacilitiesThe apartment is offered fully furnished and includes wardrobes, beds, side tables, air-conditioning units, a sofa set, dining table with chairs, television unit and essential electrical fixtures such as lights and fans in all rooms. The kitchen is functional in design with a granite platform and stainless steel sink, operating on cylinder gas. All bathrooms are fitted in western style with geysers and separate shower areas. The building provides multiple lifts with power backup for lifts, common areas and intercom facilities. An air-conditioned modern gym is available for residents. Open parking is provided on the podium level, along with visitor parking. The premises are secured with 24-hour security services and CCTV surveillance, and water supply is available round the clock with minimal power interruptions.LocalityThe property is located close to Jaslok Hospital and benefits from excellent social and civic infrastructure. Renowned landmarks such as Cumballa Hill Hospital, Greenlawns High School, Shalimar Hotel and popular retail and dining options including Croma, Starbucks and McDonald’s are within walking distance. A Jain temple is situated nearby, adding to the cultural convenience of the area. Grant Road Western Railway station is easily accessible, and public transport options including BEST AC buses, black and yellow taxis, and app-based cab services are readily available. This apartment represents a rare opportunity to own a spacious, sea-facing residence in one of Mumbai’s most exclusive and well-connected neighbourhoods.

plgdtldesc: Step into your dream home with this enchanting 3 BHK flat for sale in Arihant Darpan, Mulund East, Mumbai. Bathed in the warmth of the morning sun, this Vaastu-compliant, East-facing residence offers breathtaking sunrise views that rejuvenates your day. Property Specifications Welcome to this stunning 3 BHK flat located on the 8th floor. This residence features three fully furnished and recently renovated bedrooms, each equipped with king-size beds, spacious wardrobes with locker facilities, side tables, large dressing tables with drawers and elegant mirrors, split ACs, and even a dedicated work-from-home table with a beautiful view. The flooring throughout the apartment is adorned with imported Italian vitrified large-sized tiles, while the master bedroom boasts a sophisticated grey and white flooring that compliments its interiors. The flat includes one balcony that overlooks the adjacent building. The modular kitchen features cabinets, drawers, a pantry corner with a water purifier, electrical gadget slots, a chimney, a hob, and decorative rope lights that enhance its appeal. A piped gas connection is also available for your convenience.In the living room, you will find comfortable sofas, chairs, and a center table, along with crockery cabinets for added storage. The apartment has two bathrooms, both designed in a modern western style, complete with large mirrors, stylish washbasins, and storage cabinets. Recent renovations have ensured that all bathrooms are fitted with geyser systems and high-quality Grohe and Jaguar fittings, complemented by beautiful white and grey tiles. Facilities The apartment is equipped with all necessary electrical fixtures, including lights, fans, decorative spotlights, and backlights, ensuring a well-lit and inviting atmosphere. Residents will enjoy 100 power backup for lifts and common facilities, along with inverter backup for lights and fans within the flat. The society offers a basic air-conditioned gym with essential equipment and steam facilities for fitness enthusiasts. For parking, there is one covered car parking space available. Security is a top priority, with round-the-clock security personnel and CCTV surveillance throughout the building.

plgdtldesc: Reach the pinnacle of comfortable living at this 3 BHK flat for sale in K L Mehrise, Santacruz West, Mumbai. When you stay at this residence you are promised a peaceful lifestyle as well as excellent connectivity to all the top-amenities of the city. Property specifications Step into this fully furnished and fully centralised 3BHK flat, which is located on the 4th floor of a well-planned residential apartment of 13 floors. The flat occupies a super area of 2000 sqft and a carpet area of 1450 sqft, spacious enough to accommodate a nuclear family. The flat is well-presented with 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and a lovely living cum dining area and a modular kitchen. An additional pooja room is also available to offer prayers with complete peace of mind. All the bedrooms have huge wardrobes, and also there are lights and fans in all the rooms. All the bathrooms have modern sanitary fittings, of which two bathrooms are attached to the bedrooms respectively while two are common for guestfamily use. The well-configured modular kitchen with chimney, cabinets, granite platform and sink offers an easy functioning and organised cooking environment. The availability of piped gas connection and a utility room further ensures enough space for day-to-day activities. The flooring of Italian marble in all the rooms elevates the appearance of the entire house. Another key highlight includes the vaastu compliant floor plan with south facing entrance, promising good health and prosperity to the residents. FacilitiesFrom 2 covered parkings, 24 hours water supply, 100 power backup, 24x7 security guards, CCTVs cameras and visitor parking, the apartment has all the facilities. Additionally, 4 lifts, laundry service, water storage, kids play area, fire fighting equipment, maintenance staff, gym, and a clubhouse are all available. Locality The famous Podar international school, which is 100m away is the closest landmark to this  3 BHK flat for sale in K L Mehrise, Santacruz West. A few major medical centres such as Hinduja Hospital and Surya Hospital are available in the radius of 1km. Food Hall is in the vicinity of 500m whereas banks, ATMs, hotels and restaurants are all at a close range. The area is well connected to Santacruz railway station, which is 500m from this society.

As part of the thriving urban landscape of Mumbai, Kurla West continues to witness strong residential demand due to its strategic location, infrastructure growth and proximity to key employment centres. Offering a blend of modern comfort and strategic location, this property is perfect for families seeking a refined lifestyle in a vibrant community.Property SpecificationsThis luxurious 4 BHK flat offers a generous carpet area of 1500 sq ft, located on the 2nd floor of a 12-story building. Fully furnished and thoughtfully designed, this flat provides a comfortable and stylish living space. The property features four spacious bedrooms and four well-appointed bathroomstwo attached and two common, with geysers installed in three. There are two balconies attached to the bedrooms, offering serene views of the garden, perfect for relaxation.The flat boasts a spacious living cum dining area, ideal for entertaining guests and family gatherings. A dedicated Puja room adds a touch of spirituality to the home. The property provides a 24-hour water supply, sourced from the corporation, ensuring continuous and reliable access to water. For uninterrupted power, the flat benefits from a 100 power backup facility. Security is a top priority, with a dedicated security guard and CCTV surveillance installed throughout the premises. Additionally, there are two lifts in the building, ensuring easy and convenient access to all floors. Locality This 4 BHK flat is strategically located near the renowned Jondhale College of Engineering. The area boasts excellent connectivity and essential amenities, ensuring a convenient lifestyle for residents. Schools and hospitals are within 1 km, providing easy access to education and healthcare services. For shopping and leisure, malls and supermarkets are located within 1.5 km. Nearby banks and ATMs ensure hassle-free financial transactions.Public transport options are readily available, with buses and autos frequently servicing the area. The railway station is just 2.5 km away, offering excellent connectivity to other parts of the city. This prime location ensures that all your daily needs and conveniences are within easy reach.

plgdtldesc: Indulge in luxury living with this immaculate 8 BHK villa for sale in Naigaon East, Mumbai. With freehold ownership rights and boasting a timeless charm despite its construction age of over 20 years, this ready-to-move-in property offers an unparalleled blend of comfort and elegance.Property Specifications This spacious villa boasts a generous carpet area of 3850 square feet spread across the ground, mezzanine, and first floor. Unfurnished yet meticulously designed, this property offers a versatile layout suitable for various preferences and needs. The ground floor comprises one bedroom with an attached bathroom featuring western fittings and a geyser. Additionally, it includes a living room, kitchen, and either a store or pooja room, providing ample space for daily activities and relaxation.Moving to the first floor, you'll find another bedroom with an attached bathroom, equipped with western amenities and a geyser, along with a passage connecting the different sections. The first floor further offers two bedrooms with attached bathrooms and balconies, providing scenic views and ample natural light. The rest of the first floor opens up to an expansive terrace, perfect for outdoor gatherings or leisure activities.The kitchen is designed with functionality in mind, offering a normal layout suitable for everyday cooking needs. A utility area is also available, providing additional convenience for household tasks. The flooring throughout the villa features a combination of vitrified tiles and granite, ensuring durability and aesthetic appeal. Facing towards the west, residents can enjoy stunning sunset views and optimal natural lighting throughout the day.FacilitiesThe property includes two covered parking spaces and additional open parking for convenience. Residents benefit from 24-hour water supply, ensuring uninterrupted access to water for various needs.Locality Located within close proximity, this area offers easy access to essential amenities. Schools are conveniently situated within 1 kilometer, ensuring accessibility for families with children. Additionally, malls, supermarkets, and banks/ATMs are within a 1-2 kilometer radius, providing convenience for daily needs. Public transportation, including buses and autos, is readily available, facilitating seamless travel. Moreover, the nearby railway station enhances connectivity for commuters. While hospitals are slightly further away at 5-6 kilometers, their accessibility ensures prompt medical assistance when needed.
